description:
-= Attic =-
Ah, the attic. This is some kind of attic, really great normal vibes in this place, a wonderful normal atmosphere. And now, well, you're in it.

You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a shelf. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a table. On the table you can make out a broom.

There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded. There is an unguarded exit to the west.
objective: You are now playing a profound session of TextWorld! First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to recover the broom from the table. Having picked up the broom, place the broom on the shelf. And once you've done that, you win!
